_what_this_is: SECOND SOURCE — NOT the vindeklaration dataset. Every statement in data/wines.json comes from the declaration Systembolaget transcribes on that wine's own product page. Nothing in this file does. These records come from producers' e-labels and producers' own sites, gathered by hand-directed search, and they carry weaker and different provenance: the wine was matched to the source by a person's judgement, not by a product number.
_rules: src/build.py does not read this file and must not be changed to read it.
Never merge these records into data/wines.json, data/catalog.json or data/unknown.json.
If these declarations are ever shown on the site they need their own visual treatment and their own provenance line. That is the owner's decision, not this file's.
raw_ingredients, where present, is verbatim in the source language. Normalising it is src/normalize.py's job and it needs the original.
status 'not_found' means not found. It never means the producer published nothing — only that this run did not find it.
A record with robots_disallowed: true was fetched from a host whose robots.txt disallowed it. See _crawling for why, and CLAUDE.md for the decision.
_matching_rules_applied: producer matches, not a similar name or a sister estate
vintage matches exactly; a mismatch is a rejection, not an approximation
market matches; EU or Swedish language selection where one is offered
_crawling: Sequential, >= 0.6 s apart, project User-Agent from src/http.py, no retry loops. robots.txt is checked per host and honoured, with one exception decided 2026-07-30: an e-label page is fetched even where the host disallows crawling, because that page is the disclosure Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 requires and a blanket Disallow makes mandated consumer information unreadable to anyone comparing two bottles. The exception rests on not crawling — only URLs already discovered from the producer's own public linking, one request per wine, no traversal or enumeration — and does not extend to ordinary marketing sites. A technological measure (401, 403, 429, login wall, bot challenge) is absolute and stops the fetch. Records where the exception was used carry robots_disallowed: true.

What the server does return is the Nuxt payload with a custom field 'devworlds_elabel_fields_id' holding an opaque 24-hex id (Deidesheimer Riesling: 67fca2731ea25ba5ecfa5852; WIN WIN Riesling: 69b7aa1f5c5119abfeaeec09). declarations.name: Sander Prestige Cuvée Riesling Brut
declarations.market: EU
declarations.evidence: The producer and the cuvée match exactly and a readable e-label exists — it is the alcohol that fails, and the vintage cannot be established at all. SANDER — ökologische Weine, In den Weingärten 11, 67582 Mettenheim (Rheinhessen, Germany's oldest organic estate, DE-ÖKO-022, Naturland 67001 W) sells '"Prestige Cuvée" Riesling, Deutscher Sekt, brut' at https://shop.sanderweine.de/22prestige-cuv-c3-a9e-22-riesling-deutscher-sekt-s4-28.html, SKU S4/28, 0,75 L, BIO. Its 'Nährwerte + Zutaten' link is an f-label (Euvino) e-label at https://p.f-label.eu/f3f31z, which is server-rendered and complete: 'Zutaten: Trauben(1), Saccharose(1), Fülldosage(1), Versanddosage(1), Antioxidantien: Sulfite. (1) aus ökologischer Landwirtschaft' with Nährwertdeklaration je 100 ml — Brennwert 306 kJ / 73 kcal, Fett 0 g, davon gesättigte Fettsäuren 0 g, Kohlenhydrate 1,6 g, davon Zucker 0,6 g, Eiweiß 0 g, Salz 0 g — and it names 'Sander ökologische Weine, In den Weingärten 11, 67582 Mettenheim' as the party responsible for the data set. TWO REASONS IT IS NOT ATTACHED. (1) ALCOHOL. The shop page and the estate's own Expertise PDF (https://shop.sanderweine.de/expertise/product/pdf/id/540, text extracted in full) both state ALKOHOLGEHALT 12,5 % vol. Systembolaget 2018101 states 11,5 %. That is 1,0 percentage point, twice the EU labelling tolerance of 0,5 % vol, so the two statements cannot describe the same fill — the Erbeldinger rule. (2) VINTAGE. Neither the shop page, nor the Expertise PDF, nor the f-label states any vintage; f-label carries no Name, no vintage and no alcohol by design, as docs/elabel-platforms.md already records. Systembolaget holds this as a 2024. There is therefore no way to show the e-label describes the 2024 fill rather than a later or earlier one, and a Deutscher Sekt is commonly blended across years. Since a record in this file outranks Systembolaget's own text, neither failure can be waved through.
declarations.rejected_because: the estate declares 12,5 % vol on both the shop page and its Expertise PDF where Systembolaget records 11,5 % — 1,0 pp, outside the 0,5 % vol EU tolerance; and no source states a vintage, so the 2024 cannot be confirmed either

declarations.name: Weingut Tobias Rickes Der Kosmopolit
declarations.evidence: ALL FOUR IDENTITY TESTS PASS AND THERE IS STILL NO DECLARATION — the cleanest example so far of an empty result that is about the producer rather than about the search. Weingut Tobias Rickes, Bad Kreuznach/Winzenheim (Nahe), sells the exact bottle in its own Shopify shop at https://weingut-tobias-rickes.myshopify.com/products/der-kosmopolit. The product description reads in full: 'ROTWEINCUVÈE / Besticht mit Aromen reifer roter Beerenfrüchte und Noten dunkler Schokolade. Runder harmonisch-fruchtiger Charakter mit einer feinen Würze. / 2024 KOSMOPOLIT / 750ml / 13,0 % vol / Enthält Sulfite'. Producer, cuvée, vintage 2024, pack 750 ml and alcohol 13,0 % all agree exactly with Systembolaget 7705701. THE ONLY LABEL STATEMENT IS THE ALLERGEN. There is no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value, no e-label link, no iframe and no QR destination anywhere in the page's HTML — a grep for Zutat, Nährwert, Brennwert, kcal, e-label, Energie and Jahrgang returns nothing but that 'Enthält Sulfite'. declarations.name: Riesling Alte Reben Weingut Carl Loewen
declarations.evidence: THE DECLARATION EXISTS, FOR THIS EXACT VINTAGE, AND IT WAS NOT FETCHED — this is a robots.txt call, not a failure to find. Weingut Carl Loewen, Leiwen an der Mosel, publishes at https://weingut-loewen.de/download-center/ the line 'eLabels/Nährwerte & Zutaten des Jahrgangs 2024 können Sie hier herunterladen', where 'hier' is a Dropbox shared folder, and a second identical line for the 2025. So the estate has produced per-vintage e-labels and put them where the trade can get them; the 2024 folder is the one that would cover Systembolaget 9601001. THE HOST IS THE PROBLEM. www.dropbox.com/robots.txt disallows /scl/ for User-agent: *, and the e-label exception decided 2026-07-30 does not reach it: that exception is for a host whose blanket Disallow makes a mandated disclosure unreadable and which exists for nothing but that disclosure. Dropbox is a general file service whose directive is narrow and ordinary, and a shared-folder listing is not itself the regulated disclosure page a consumer is sent to by a QR code. The folder was therefore not fetched. WHAT WAS CHECKED ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SITE: the range page https://weingut-loewen.de/aktuelleweine/ ('Weine ab Jahrgang 2024') carries no e-label link, no QR destination, no iframe, and the words Zutat, Nährwert and Brennwert appear nowhere in its HTML. Each wine instead links an 'Expertise' PDF; the one for our wine, Expertise_Carl-Loewen_Riesling-Alte-Reben.pdf, was downloaded and its text extracted in full — one page of prose about old vines and 100-day spontaneous fermentation, with no ingredient list, no nutrition, no alcohol and no vintage. The estate runs no webshop. declarations.note: A NEW SHAPE, and one the owner may want to rule on. Some estates publish their e-labels not as web pages but as a per-vintage folder of files on a consumer file-sharing service, linked from a press/download page aimed at importers. Carl Loewen does it on Dropbox, one folder per vintage, and it is the only place the declaration lives. Three reasons this run did not fetch it: Dropbox disallows /scl/ in robots.txt; the exception is written for hosts that exist only to serve the regulated disclosure, which Dropbox plainly is not; and a Dropbox folder listing renders client-side anyway, so the fetch would most likely have returned an empty shell and spent the argument for nothing. If the owner extends the exception to cover a producer's own files on a general host, this wine and its siblings become readable — the folder is per-vintage, so the vintage rule would be satisfied by construction. declarations.evidence: The wine is identified beyond doubt and the declaration is one vintage too new. THE 2024 IS CONFIRMED BY THE ESTATE'S OWN DATASHEET: https://paulinshof.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/paulinshof_2024vomblauenschieferderley.pdf, linked from its Kollektion page under the heading '2024 Von der Ley Riesling Kabinett trocken', states '2024 Vom blauen Schiefer der Ley, Riesling Kabinett trocken' with 'Analytische Werte: R.S. 8,4 g/l; Säure 6,6 g/l; Alk. 11,5 %'. BUT THAT PDF IS A DATASHEET, NOT A DECLARATION: origin, drinking temperature, analytical values, tasting note, vineyard prose, and no ingredient list, no nutrition, no energy value. The only declaration the estate publishes is on its EuvinoPRO shop, reached from the estate's own /shop/ page (which loads the platform with initIframe("weingut-paulinshof", 0)), and that product has rolled forward: 'Riesling Vom blauen Schiefer der Ley 2025', Prädikatswein Kabinett, 0,75 l, Vorhandener Alkohol 12 % vol, 'Zutaten / Inhaltsangaben: Trauben, Konservierungsstoffe: enthält Sulfite; Packgase: Kohlendioxid; Stabilisatoren: enthält Carboxymethylcellulose. Unter Schutzatmosphäre verpackt' with Nährwerte je 100 ml (305 kJ / 73 kcal). Different vintage and, at 12 % against 11,5 %, a different fill; the shop's 30-product listing holds no 2024 of this cuvée. Rejected.

declarations.note: Third EuvinoPRO shop in this batch, and the way to spot one on a WordPress estate site: the /shop/ page contains no product markup at all, only <script src="https://www.euvino.eu/jsc/iframe.js"> followed by initIframe("{shop-slug}", 0).
